newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Neuhaus up 24 pct on first day on bourse.
newsitem.headline: Neuhaus up 24 pct on first day on bourse.

text.p: Shares in Belgian chocolate maker Neuhaus NV rose 24 percent on their first day of bourse trade on Tuesday.

Controlling shareholder Artal Nederland BV last month sold 450,000 Neuhaus shares in an initial public offering (IPO) priced at 1,750 francs. It also applied to have all the company's 750,000 shares listed on the Brussels Stock Exchange.
The shares, which are fixed twice-daily, closed at 2,170 francs with a hefty 83,667 shares, or 18.6 percent of the offer size, traded.
Dealers said institutions, which found themselves squeezed out of the 15 times oversubscribed IPO, were the main buyers.
